main.description: Where a personal account is based. Mirrors the `location` field of app.certified.actor.organization for accounts that are people rather than organizations — the profile lexicon has no location slot, and writing an organization record would misclassify the account. Points at an app.certified.location record in the same repo; that record may be an exact point, a country centroid, or (when the person chose to share only an approximate location) a ~10 km circle around a deliberately offset point. Fixed rkey `self`: one declared location per account. Delete the record to clear the location.

location.description: A strong reference to the location where the person is based. The record referenced must conform with the lexicon app.certified.location.
